title: Generate the calibration PDF structure
description: Generate a deterministic calibration scene and PDF with explicit physical page geometry, documented measurement marks, and persistent software-only labeling, without presenting the artifact as physical evidence.
acceptanceCriteria: Calibration output uses the exact TASK-95 layout binding and explicit page boxes
Measurement marks have documented identities, coordinates, units, and reading instructions
Scene, PDF, and UI metadata label the artifact as software-generated structure rather than physical evidence
Equivalent normalized inputs produce equivalent scene data and byte-identical PDF output
Parsed PDF tests verify page boxes and marks without asserting ink placement

steps.details: Create framework-neutral mark primitives with stable IDs, millimetre coordinates, units, and textual measurement instructions.
Use the shared scene boundary and exact layout binding to produce page geometry, marks, and visible software-only evidence disclosure.
Route the scene through the isolated PDF renderer with explicit page boxes and stable metadata/order.
Parse focused fixtures to check page boxes, mark coordinates, disclosure text, deterministic bytes, and no physical-success wording.

technicalNotes: Maximum execution scope is ten minutes; support one small deterministic calibration fixture.
PDF geometry and marks are software evidence only and cannot prove where ink lands.
